rules.title: KubePersistentVolumeFillingUp
rules.expression:
(
  kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job!=""}
    /
  kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job!=""}
) < 0.03
and
kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job!=""} > 0
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

annotations.description: The PersistentVolume claimed by {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} {{ with $labels.cluster -}} on Cluster {{ . }} {{- end }} is only {{ $values.query.Value | humanizePercentage }} free.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolume is filling up.

rules.title: KubePersistentVolumeFillingUp
rules.expression:
(
  kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job!=""}
    /
  kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job!=""}
) < 0.15
and
kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job!=""} > 0
and
predict_linear(kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{job!=""}[6h], 4 * 24 * 3600) < 0
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

annotations.description: Based on recent sampling, the PersistentVolume claimed by {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} {{ with $labels.cluster -}} on Cluster {{ . }} {{- end }} is expected to fill up within four days. Currently {{ $values.query.Value | humanizePercentage }} is available.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolume is filling up.

rules.title: KubePersistentVolumeInodesFillingUp
rules.expression:
(
  kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_free{job!=""}
    /
  kubelet_volume_stats_inodes{job!=""}
) < 0.03
and
kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_used{job!=""} > 0
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

annotations.description: The PersistentVolume claimed by {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in Namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} {{ with $labels.cluster -}} on Cluster {{ . }} {{- end }} only has {{ $values.query.Value | humanizePercentage }} free inodes.
annotations.summary: PersistentVolumeInodes are filling up.

rules.title: KubePersistentVolumeInodesFillingUp
rules.expression:
(
  kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_free{job!=""}
    /
  kubelet_volume_stats_inodes{job!=""}
) < 0.15
and
kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_used{job!=""} > 0
and
predict_linear(kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_free{job!=""}[6h], 4 * 24 * 3600) < 0
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_access_mode{ access_mode="ReadOnlyMany"} == 1
unless on(cluster, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_excluded_from_alerts="true"} == 1

rules.title: KubeletTooManyPods

annotations.description: Kubelet '{{ $labels.node }}' is running at {{ $values.query.Value | humanizePercentage }} of its Pod capacity on cluster {{ $labels.cluster }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet is running at capacity.

rules.title: KubeNodeReadinessFlapping
rules.expression:
sum(changes(kube_node_status_condition{job!="",status="true",condition="Ready"}[15m])) by (cluster, node) > 2
and on (cluster, node)
kube_node_spec_unschedulable{job!=""} == 0

annotations.description: The readiness status of node {{ $labels.node }} has changed {{ $values.query.Value }} times in the last 15 minutes on cluster {{ $labels.cluster }}.
annotations.summary: Node readiness status is flapping.

rules.title: KubeNodeEviction

annotations.description: Node {{ $labels.node }} on {{ $labels.cluster }} is evicting Pods due to {{ $labels.eviction_signal }}.  Eviction occurs when eviction thresholds are crossed, typically caused by Pods exceeding RAM/ephemeral-storage limits.
annotations.summary: Node is evicting pods.

rules.title: KubeletPlegDurationHigh
rules.expression:
(histogram_quantile(
  0.99,
  sum(rate(kubelet_pleg_relist_duration_seconds_bucket{job!=""}[5m])) by (cluster, instance, le)
  * on(cluster, instance) group_left (node)
  max by (cluster, instance, node) (kubelet_node_name{job!=""})
)) >= 10

annotations.description: The Kubelet Pod Lifecycle Event Generator has a 99th percentile duration of {{ $values.query.Value }} seconds on node {{ $labels.node }} on cluster {{ $labels.cluster }}.
annotations.summary: Kubelet Pod Lifecycle Event Generator is taking too long to relist.
